reason: Those settlement checks are like ten dollars if you even get one, and I still have to file the claim myself on some other website. I am not making an account and spending an evening on that for grocery-coupon money.
objection: If I still have to go to the administrator site and fill out the form myself, I will just forget, same as I do with every notice sitting in my inbox that I already assume is spam.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually filed for me and showed I was in line for something like thirty dollars or more, not ten, I might try it once.
